comparator.route: Kunstgeschiedenis, standard route without study abroad, two permitted minors
comparator.sourceNotes: The public prospective pages explicitly form a single three-year entry-cohort sequence, 60+60+60 EC. Year one has twelve compulsory 5-EC courses; the 0-EC mentorship and RADAr elements do not contribute credit. Year two has 30 EC specified major courses and 30 EC of two restricted 15-EC Arts minors, whose individual courses are not imposed on all students. Year three without study abroad has Florence 10, American Art 5, Kunstwerelden 5, research work 10 and genuine free space 30 EC. The formally adopted 2026–27 OER describes a different current-cohort year-three list, including the exact same Paris course code also listed in its year two, and a career course rather than the later prospective Kunstwerelden. That cross-cohort single-year regulation is not combined as if both Paris instances could earn credit in one three-year route. The prospective sequence is provisional and future offerings may change; the 2026–27 OER confirms the current first-year field and broad 60/30+30/30+30 structure but is not represented as adopting the future year-three Florence list.
